in_sanskrit.name: रविराजशिंह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ruler of the army of Lord Ravi (Sun God), King of the bow of Lord Ravi.

in_hindi.name: रविराजशिंह
in_hindi.meaning: सूर्य राजा, रविके धनुष के राजा
in_hindi.long_meaning: King of the Sun, King of the bow of Lord Ravi.

in_tamil.name: ரவிராஜசிங்க
in_tamil.long_meaning: King of Sun, Prince of the bow of Lord Ravi.

in_telugu.name: రవిరాజేశ్వర
in_telugu.long_meaning: King of the Sun, Lord of the bow of Lord Ravi.

in_marathi.name: Ravirajsinh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ravirajsinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ravi means god and Rajsinh means king. This name is a combination of two powerful words that symbolize power, victory, and courage.

in_bengali.name: Ravirajsinh
